steps.summary: Run straight North-West along the aqueduct channels into Highgate (Act 9 Town)
steps.layout_tell: Identical to Act 4 Aqueduct: cross side bridges whenever a gate blocks your lane.
steps.next_exit: Enter Highgate → Exit top-right into The Descent
steps.portal_tip: Best XP farming zone in the campaign if you want to hit Level 60–62 quickly!

actions.text: Run straight NW along the blood channels into Highgate
In Highgate, exit top-right into The Descent

steps.summary: Act 9 Town Hub → Tag Waypoint → Climb North-East stairs to The Descent
steps.layout_tell: Enter from Blood Aqueduct on the left; climb the long North-East wooden stairs past Petarus & Vanja to enter The Descent.
steps.next_exit: Climb NE stairs → Enter The Descent → Supply Hoist to Vastiri Desert
steps.portal_tip: Turn in Storm Blade to Petarus & Vanja for the Bottled Storm (unlocks The Oasis +1 Skill Pt)!

actions.text: Tag Act 9 Highgate Waypoint
Climb top-right (NE) stairs into The Descent

steps.boss_info: Safe Town Hub (Petarus & Vanja, Tasuni, Irasha, Sin).
steps.gem_reward: Irasha/Tasuni rewards +1 Passive Skill Point for Sekhema Feather (The Ruler of Highgate).

variants.title: Fixed Town Hub
variants.desc: NE stairs lead to The Descent.

steps.summary: Descend via Supply Hoist into Vastiri Desert → Tag WP → Clear Storm-Weathered Chest (Storm Blade) → Open The Oasis & Kill Shakari (+1 Pt!)
steps.layout_tell: In Vastiri Desert: find the Waypoint & the Storm-Weathered Chest; after getting Bottled Storm from Town, head to the outer edge for The Oasis!
steps.next_exit: Kill Shakari in The Oasis (+1 Skill Pt!) → Exit North of Desert into The Foothills
steps.portal_tip: After looting the Storm Blade, talk to Petarus & Sin in Town to get the Bottled Storm that clears the sandstorm blocking The Oasis!

actions.text: Tag Vastiri Desert Waypoint & clear ambush at Storm-Weathered Chest (Storm Blade)
Get Bottled Storm from Town → Enter The Oasis → Kill Shakari (+1 Skill Pt!)
Take North exit of Vastiri Desert into The Foothills

steps.boss_info: Shakari, Queen of the Sands: Burrowing tail slams & quicksand traps. Keep moving along the dry sand!
steps.gem_reward: Queen of the Sands (Irasha in Town): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point)!

variants.title: Desert Perimeter
variants.desc: Foothills exit is always at the top (North); Oasis is along the East/NE wall.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural desert: Storm Blade, Waypoint, and Oasis (+1 Pt Shakari) locations vary across seeds

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint (North-East) → Enter The Boiling Lake to kill The Basilisk (Basilisk Acid) → Exit North-West into The Tunnel
steps.layout_tell: In The Foothills: North-East = Waypoint & The Boiling Lake; North-West = The Tunnel!
steps.next_exit: Kill The Basilisk in Boiling Lake (Acid) → Enter The Tunnel (NW)
steps.portal_tip: In The Boiling Lake, follow the dry stone islands North-East to the petrified soldiers & The Basilisk!

actions.text: Head NE to tag The Foothills Waypoint
Enter The Boiling Lake (NE) → Kill The Basilisk & loot Basilisk Acid
Return to Foothills & head North-West into The Tunnel

steps.boss_info: The Basilisk: Petrifying gaze beam — stand behind stone statues or run behind him when he channels!
steps.gem_reward: Basilisk Acid is 1 of 2 items needed for Sin to open The Belly of the Beast.

variants.title: Foothills Fork
variants.desc: NE = WP + Boiling Lake; NW = The Tunnel.

topology.procedural_note: Foothills WP & Calendar of Fortune are North/NE; Boiling Lake is East; Tunnel is NW

steps.summary: Complete Merciless Lab Trial #2 (usually right before or next to the Waypoint!) → Continue North into The Quarry
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ TUNNEL TRIAL TELL: Merciless Trial #2 almost always spawns within 1 screen of The Tunnel Waypoint!
steps.next_exit: Complete Merciless Trial #2 → Enter The Quarry
steps.portal_tip: Can also be run anytime via The Tunnel Waypoint!

actions.text: Complete Merciless Lab Trial #2 (Roomba Discs & Spikes — 2/3)
Tag The Tunnel Waypoint
Follow tracks North into The Quarry

variants.title: Linear North Shaft
variants.desc: Trial is along the main path near the WP.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural tunnel: Merciless Lab Trial #2 spawns in a side branch BEFORE the Waypoint!

steps.summary: Run to the exact CENTER of the zone to tag the Waypoint & Sin → Check NW & NE walls for Garukhan (+1 Pt!) & The Refinery!
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ QUARRY TELL: Waypoint & Sin are ALWAYS dead-center; Shrine of the Winds (Garukhan +1 Pt) and The Refinery are ALWAYS at the North-West and North-East edges!
steps.next_exit: Kill Garukhan (+1 Skill Pt!) + Loot Trarthan Powder in The Refinery → Give to Sin at Center WP → Enter Belly of the Beast
steps.portal_tip: After killing General Adus & looting Trarthan Powder in The Refinery, Logout → Take WP back to The Quarry center!

actions.text: Run to the center of The Quarry & tag the Waypoint
Check NW/NE edge for Shrine of the Winds → Kill Kira & Garukhan (+1 Pt!)
Enter The Refinery (other top corner) → Kill General Adus & loot Trarthan Powder
Talk to Sin at Quarry WP to open The Belly of the Beast

steps.boss_info: Garukhan, Queen of the Winds (Physical/Bleed sand tornadoes) & General Adus (Heavy Lightning slams in Refinery).
steps.gem_reward: The Ruler of Highgate (Irasha in Town): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point)!

variants.title: Center Hub + Top Corners
variants.desc: Center = WP/Sin; NW & NE = Shrine of the Winds & Refinery.

topology.procedural_note: Sin & Waypoint are dead-center; Shrine of the Winds (+1 Pt) & Refinery spawn on random N/W/E walls

steps.summary: Run NW through Belly of the Beast into The Rotting Core → Enter Black Heart → Defeat Shavronne, Maligaro & Doedre → Kill The Depraved Trinity
steps.layout_tell: In The Rotting Core, follow the main fleshy bridges to Sin & the Black Heart portal, then clear the 3 rapid boss rooms.
steps.next_exit: Kill The Depraved Trinity → Sail with Lilly Roth to Oriath Docks (Act 10)
steps.portal_tip: After killing the 3 bosses in their sub-portals, Sin opens the final portal to The Depraved Trinity!

actions.text: Run through Belly of the Beast & Rotting Core into The Black Heart
Defeat Doedre, Maligaro & Shavronne in their 3 sequential portals
Kill The Depraved Trinity → Sail with Lilly to Act 10

steps.boss_info: The Depraved Trinity: Combines Fire/Lightning/Chaos attacks and rising blood walls.
steps.gem_reward: Completes Act 9 and opens Act 10 (Oriath Docks).

variants.title: Linear Boss Gauntlet
variants.desc: Three quick sub-arenas followed by the Trinity arena.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural organic maze through Belly of the Beast & Rotting Core to the 3 Guardian Portals
